title: Homegames. An open-source game platform I've been making for 8 years
claim: Show HN: Homegames. An open-source game platform I've been making for 8 years
why_good: An 8-year labor-of-love open-source game platform (play together on any screen) — deep dedication, but long without a breakout.
value: Games/platforms monetize via a hit or a marketplace; 8 years in with modest traction is a warning on the model.
risk: Long runway without escape velocity; couch-multiplayer platforms are hard to monetize and hit-driven.

zh.claim: Show HN: Homegames —— 我做了 8 年的开源游戏平台。
zh.why_good: 一个做了 8 年的爱之作开源游戏平台(在任意屏幕上一起玩)——投入很深,但长期没有爆发。
